title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Rises 2.3% as Chip Stocks Rebound (Nov 3)
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) closed at $206.69 on Nov 3, 2026, up 2.29%, as chip stocks rebounded from a selloff. Session data, China risk and the Nov 17 results call.
body_markdown:
## Why Nvidia Stock Rose


No fetched source tied Tuesday's gain to company-specific news; financial media tied it to a rebound across chip stocks. As reported by[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/micron-nvidia-amd-lead-chip-stocks-rebound-140538628.html) , semiconductor stocks rose on Tuesday after[steep losses in the previous session](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/broadcom-avgo-stock-news-november-3-2026/) , with Micron recovering part of Monday's 7% drop and AMD recouping some of its own 7% loss ahead of its[quarterly results](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/midterms-apple-palantir-and-amd-tonight/) .


According to[Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/11/03/nvidia-up-over-3-whats-driving-tuesdays-rally/) , the gain snapped a four-session losing streak for Nvidia, whose shares had fallen more than 11% over the prior 30 days amid concerns about whether the AI investment boom can last. Yahoo Finance noted that worries about AI spending and neocloud debt had weighed on the sector, and that chip and memory stocks had lost about $3.7 trillion in market value since October 6 by its own calculation.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Company outlook: in its[second-quarter fiscal 2027 results](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000073/q2fy27pr.htm) on August 26, Nvidia reported revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% from a year ago, and said it expects third-quarter revenue of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
- Data Center scale: the same release put Data Center revenue at $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year ago.
- AI build-out: Yahoo Finance described semiconductor companies as key beneficiaries of the AI build-out.


### Risks


- China limits for cloud partners: the Financial Times reported, as relayed by AFP via[Tech Xplore](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-nvidia-center-clients-china-exposure.html) , that Nvidia told data center partners to sell at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese companies on future contracts, citing five people with knowledge of the matter. Nvidia neither confirmed nor denied the report and said "America cannot win the AI race unless America's AI infrastructure wins worldwide."
- China outside the guidance: Nvidia said it is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its third-quarter outlook.
- AI spending worries: Yahoo Finance said concerns over AI spending and neocloud debt had weighed on chip stocks in recent weeks, and Nvidia still closed 15.07% below its 52-week high.


The next confirmed event is Nvidia's fiscal third-quarter[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) . According to the company's[own notice](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873) , it will host a conference call on Tuesday, November 17, at 2 p.m. PT (5 p.m. ET) to discuss results for the quarter that ended October 25, 2026.


This article is for education and information only and is not investment advice. Investment decisions are yours to make after your own research.
